claims.evidence: Witness read the body label as 'PSR-550', but the item is stated to actually be a PSR650 — the model identity and the label do not match, a sign of a mismatched or altered plate.
No power-on, key-press, or audio clip in the report; a flat overhead photo cannot show function.

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch (label says PSR-550, true model said to be PSR650)
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the full model plate/serial number, cross-checked against an official Yamaha model list
risks.if_unproven: price as unverifiable identity / treat as the lower-value or ambiguous model until resolved

risks.risk: Power adapter not shown, may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter/cable sitting next to the unit

risks.risk: Keys/buttons may not all function despite 'working perfectly' claim
risks.proof: Video of the keyboard powered on, each octave and button pressed

risks.risk: Speaker/audio quality unknown, grille is dusty/stained which can indicate age or neglect
risks.proof: Short audio/video clip of the keyboard playing through its speakers

risks.risk: Internal electronics condition (corrosion, loose connections) not visible
risks.proof: Photo/video of the keyboard opened or a technician's note
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown risk, assume possible repair cost

risks.risk: Missing accessories (stand, sustain pedal, bag) that affect bundle value
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as keyboard only, no accessories

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the full model plate and serial number
Power-on video showing LCD screen, all buttons, and a full octave of keys being pressed
Short audio/video clip of sound output through the built-in speakers
Photo of any included power adapter, pedal, stand, or bag
response.reason: The seller's claimed and photographed label (PSR-550) directly conflicts with the stated true model (PSR650), a mismatch serious enough to suspect a relabeled or misrepresented unit until the serial number is verified.
